title: Power Automate: share Process license capacity across cloud flows with flow groups
summary: Hold for two governance and licensing qualifications. Microsoft says Process capacity cannot currently be used in pay-as-you-go environments, and Dataverse security roles control creation of records, contrary to the briefing's broad absence of controls beyond maker permissions. The creation path and REST operation are documented; the monitoring checklist also lacks corresponding table coverage.

claims.where: Governance controls: first paragraph; Open questions: first bullet
claims.claim: Learn documents no admin setting limiting who can create flow groups beyond maker permissions.
claims.quote: To control access to data and resources, you can create or modify security roles and change the security roles that are assigned to users. ... | Create | Required to make a new record |
claims.fix: Replace the Governance controls sentence with 'Learn documents no admin setting that turns flow groups off at the time of writing (November 2026), and the feature page states that no admin action is required to enable it.' Narrow the first Open questions bullet to 'Which named security roles have the privileges to create or change flowgroup records? Watch the Learn pages on flow groups.' The cited flowgroup reference identifies a Dataverse table, and https://learn.microsoft.com/power-platform/admin/security-roles-privileges documents role-controlled record creation; the specific role assignments remain unpublished.
